component.name: Study Buddy
component.summary: Turn lecture PDFs into an exam plan you can finish

description.p: Study Buddy reads your lecture slides and study notes, every page including diagrams and formulas, and turns them into active study: notes for each page, quick tests on the page you just read, spaced-repetition flashcards timed to your exam, quizzes and mock exams.
Its exam triage planner takes the time you have and a target score and decides which topics to learn fully, which only at core level and which to skip, with the reason and the expected score.

ul.li: Works with any PDF, including image-only slides
Answers and questions cite the page they come from
Tutor chat, printable cheat sheet, Anki export, bookmarks and notes
Runs on your Claude subscription through Claude Code, or an Anthropic API key

description.p: First release: page notes, Test me, flashcards, quizzes, exam triage planner, tutor chat, cheat sheet.
